title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 2: Black Molly
native_title: アクアゾーン・オプション・ディスク・シリーズ２ ～ブラック・モーリー～
overview:
The AQUAZONE world expands even further with new fish, water plants, accessories and background images!

This is the second option disc for Aquazone, the tropical fish tank simulator. It brings black mollies to raise in your virtual aquarium, along with new plants, items and scenery for the tank.

- New fish: black molly
- New water plant: microsorum
- New item: GH Balance Plus
- New accessories: a kagami mochi rice cake, a spindle shell and a grand piano
- Six new background images
- Requires the Aquazone Sega Saturn disc

新しい魚、水草、アクセサリー、背景画によってさらに拡がるAQUAZONEワールド!
